name: Conditions Subtable
notes: Benefits, Hazards, and Conditions: roll 1D10 for each category. Benefits apply on 8+ (Wealthy Individual 5+); Hazards on 8+ (Secretive Group 5+); Conditions on 8+ (Corporation 5+). If you have worked for this Patron before, the Benefit (if any) always remains the same. Benefits are paid out ONLY if the mission is a success.

rows.detail: If the mission fails, the Patron becomes a Rival.
Danger Pay is only upon success.
You cannot deploy more than 4 crew.
You cannot ever have made law enforcement Rivals.
If the mission is a success, the Patron offers a new job next campaign turn.
This Patron cannot be retained as a contact.
You must have completed a prior Patron job on this world.
